name: handler_ntfy
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported via the Ntfy.sh Messaging Service

origin.description: Build a progression handler that sends an ntfy.sh message.
origin.usage: handler_ntfy(intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.ntfy", 5), target = "gui", ..., title = "Progress update from R")

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.ntfy, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: title
arguments.text: Notification title. The default is "Progress update from R".

origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_ntfy(), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_ntfy() errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would send an ntfy.sh message.
translation.usage: handler_ntfy(intrusiveness=None, target="gui", *, title="Progress update from R", **extra)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.ntfy, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: title
arguments.text: Notification title. The default is "Progress update from R".

translation.details: The call stops when ntfy is missing, before any message is sent.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
